paper_title: Bulk Heterojunction Organic Photovoltaics Based on Carboxylated Polythiophenes and PCBM on Glass and Plastic Substrates
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Adv Funct Materials - 2011 - Worfolk - Bulk Heterojunction Organic Photovoltaics Based on Carboxylated Polythiophenes and/auto/Adv Funct Materials - 2011 - Worfolk - Bulk Heterojunction Organic Photovoltaics Based on Carboxylated Polythiophenes and.md

knowledge_points.content: A series of regioregular poly[3-(carboxyalkyl)thiophene-2,5-diyl] (P3CAT) polymers with carboxyalkyl side chains [-(CH2)xCOOH] where x ranges from 3 to 6 (propyl, butyl, pentyl, hexyl) was synthesized for bulk heterojunction OPVs.
knowledge_points.evidence: In an effort to establish poly[3-(carboxyalkyl)thiophene-2,5- diyl]s (P3CATs) as suitable donor materials for BHJ OPVs, we investigated the polymer series containing carboxyalkyl sidechains [-(CH2)xCOOH; for x ranging from 3 to 6].

knowledge_points.content: The incorporation of carboxylic acid groups in P3CATs leads to interchain hydrogen bonding, which is confirmed by infrared spectroscopy showing free C=O stretches at ~1733 cm⁻¹ and hydrogen-bonded C=O vibrations at ~1700 cm⁻¹.
knowledge_points.evidence: The carbonyl regions for all spectra consist of two peaks corresponding to free C=O stretches at higher energy (~1733 cm⁻¹) and hydrogen bonded C=O vibrations at lower energy (~1700 cm⁻¹). All P3CATs have significant hydrogen bonded C=O vibrational modes, pointing to interchain cross linking of the polymers.

knowledge_points.content: The HOMO energy levels of the P3CAT series (-5.12 to -5.19 eV) are significantly lower than that of P3HT (-4.8 eV), which potentially allows for higher open-circuit voltages (Voc) in donor-acceptor blends with PCBM.
knowledge_points.evidence: The onset of oxidation for the P3CATs ranged from 0.27 to 0.34 V, corresponding to HOMO energies ranging from -5.19 to -5.12 eV... HOMO energies of the P3CATs are lower in energy compared to P3HT (-4.8 eV), which suggests that a higher Voc for P3CAT:PCBM BHJs may be possible.

knowledge_points.content: P3CPenT (x=5) achieved the highest power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 2.6% on glass substrates, attributed to its larger crystallite size (9.2 nm) and higher hole mobility compared to other polymers in the series.
knowledge_points.evidence: The best photovoltaic performance was measured for P3CPenT (x = 5) which achieved η = 2.6%... The P3CPenT devices exhibit superior PV performance due to larger polymer crystallite sizes, relatively high hole mobilities... crystallite sizes for... P3CPenT... BHJ films were determined to be 9.2 nm.

knowledge_points.content: A mixed solvent system of pyridine and chlorobenzene is required to process P3CAT:PCBM blends, with pyridine content limited to 25% v/v to prevent PCBM precipitation.
knowledge_points.evidence: Initial solubility experiments revealed that PCBM precipitates in mixtures with high pyridine content... which therefore limits the solvent composition to include no more than 25% v/v pyridine. For the distinct P3CAT:PCBM combinations, the optimum solvent ratios were identified as 1:7, 1:8, 1:6, and 1:7 pyridine:chlorobenzene.

knowledge_points.content: Glancing angle X-ray diffraction (XRD) reveals a linear relationship between the carboxyalkyl chain length (x=3-6) and the (100) crystal plane d-spacing, which ranges from 12.1 Å to 19.0 Å.
knowledge_points.evidence: For P3CProT, P3CButT, P3CPenT, and P3CHexT, the d-spacings were 12.1 Å, 14.1 Å, 16.8 Å, and 19.0 Å respectively... An obvious linear relationship exists between (100) d-spacing and carboxyalkyl chain length.

knowledge_points.content: Hole mobilities in P3CAT films, determined using the space charge limited current (SCLC) model with the field-corrected Mott-Gurney equation, range from 7.5 x 10⁻⁵ to 3.9 x 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹.
knowledge_points.evidence: The hole mobility in P3CAT materials was determined in devices with the following architecture: ITO/PEDOT:PSS/P3CAT/Al... The calculated mobilities of the P3CAT films range from 7.5 x 10⁻⁵ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ to 3.9 x 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹.

knowledge_points.content: Nanoindentation measurements show that P3CAT polymers are mechanically stiffer and harder than P3HT, with P3CProT exhibiting the highest Young's modulus (3.8 GPa) and hardness (0.17 GPa).
knowledge_points.evidence: For P3CAT-only films, we measured average indentation moduli in the range from 3.8 to 1.5 GPa, and hardness values from 0.17 to 0.09 GPa... in each case, the values for P3CAT films exceed those measured for P3HT (1.4 GPa modulus, 0.08 GPa hardness).

knowledge_points.content: The introduction of PCBM into P3CAT films significantly increases the Young's modulus (e.g., 5.3 GPa for P3CPenT:PCBM) due to the 'filler effect' in particle-loaded polymer films.
knowledge_points.evidence: In each case, the introduction of PCBM significantly increased the Young’s modulus of the films, with moduli ranging from 5.3 to 4.0 GPa... These increased values are consistent with the literature, as the 'filler effect' routinely leads to increased mechanical properties.

knowledge_points.content: Flexible OPV devices using P3CHexT:PCBM on PET-ITO substrates achieved a PCE of 1.62%, which is comparable to P3HT:PCBM devices (1.57%) on the same substrate.
knowledge_points.evidence: The P3CHexT:PCBM device on PET-ITO had comparable performance to the P3HT:PCBM device... P3CHexT on PET-ITO: Best n 1.62%.
